shader.note: No Unity shader is created or assumed by this specification. The eventual shader must be validated against the Sons of the Forest runtime.

assetBundle.note: This specification does not represent a built asset bundle.

emissionMask.purpose: Enables emission over the letter material; the glow color is supplied by the material parameter.

glowColor.note: Set per material or material instance; do not bake the color into EmissionMask.

baseColor.note: Do not use the brick-background albedo source as the final base color.

excludedSourceTextures.reason: Contains black emissive data; use the white 1x1 EmissionMask instead.
Contains black data and is not a reliable final metallic map.
Use only as the source for the prepared Smoothness map, not as a direct final input.

sizes.note: All sizes share the same textures and material parameters. Exact world units and pivots require target-runtime validation.
